Written to `HANDOFF.md`.

**Roll back `dep-4471`.** It flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `true`. The pool stayed at 20 connections. Requests stopped sharing and ran it dry.

Impact ran 02:14:18Z to 03:59:27Z and is still going. The log never shows a recovery.

Two things in there you may not have seen. `/v1/profile` logged no completions at all after onset. Those requests hung instead of failing. And `/health` stayed green the whole time, so health-based alerts would not fire.

This log is node-3 of 3. Worth checking the other two nodes.
